notes: Crop guessing game (hangman style). 'word' is what the player spells. Hints: 'wapi' = where it is grown in Tanzania, 'nini' = what it is popular for. Have an agronomist or Tanzanian editor confirm growing regions before launch.

crops.wapi: Hulimwa karibu kila mkoa; mikoa mikubwa ni Ruvuma, Mbeya, Rukwa na Iringa.
crops.nini: Unga wake hupikwa ugali, chakula kikuu cha Watanzania wengi.
crops.en_fact: Grown almost everywhere; its flour makes ugali.

crops.nini: Hupikwa kama ndizi nyama au matoke, na huliwa zikiwa mbivu.
crops.en_fact: Cooked as ndizi nyama or matoke, or eaten ripe.

crops.wapi: Pwani: Tanga, Pwani, Dar es Salaam, Lindi, Mtwara na Zanzibar.
crops.nini: Tui lake hupika wali wa nazi na mchuzi wa samaki.
crops.en_fact: Coconut milk cooks wali wa nazi and fish curry.

crops.nini: Majani yake hutengeneza kinywaji cha kila asubuhi, chai ya maziwa au ya rangi.
crops.en_fact: Highland crop behind the everyday cup of chai.

crops.wapi: Kilimanjaro, Kagera, Mbeya, Songwe na Ruvuma.
crops.nini: Kahawa ya miteremko ya Kilimanjaro inauzwa duniani kote.
crops.en_fact: A major export, famous from Kilimanjaro's slopes.

crops.wapi: Kanda ya Ziwa: Shinyanga, Simiyu, Mwanza na Geita.
crops.nini: Nyuzi zake hutengeneza vitambaa, kanga na nguo.
crops.en_fact: Lake Zone crop; its fibre becomes cloth and kanga.

crops.wapi: Morogoro (Kilombero), Mbeya (Kyela na Mbarali) na Shinyanga.
crops.nini: Hukobolewa kuwa mchele wa wali. Mchele wa Kyela ni maarufu.
crops.en_fact: Husked into rice; Kyela rice is well known.

crops.wapi: Mtwara, Lindi, Tanga, Pwani na Kanda ya Ziwa.
crops.nini: Huchomwa, hupikwa au husagwa kuwa unga. Majani yake ni kisamvu.
crops.en_fact: Roasted, boiled or milled; the leaves are kisamvu.

crops.nini: Mbegu zake hukamuliwa mafuta ya kupikia.
crops.en_fact: Pressed for cooking oil in central Tanzania.

crops.wapi: Mtwara na Lindi, pamoja na Pwani na Ruvuma.
crops.nini: Zao kubwa la biashara la kusini; Tanzania ni mmoja wa wazalishaji wakubwa Afrika.
crops.en_fact: The south's big cash crop; a major African producer.

crops.nini: Kiungo maarufu cha Zanzibar, hutumika kwenye pilau na chai.
crops.en_fact: Zanzibar's famous spice, used in pilau and chai.

crops.nini: Nyuzi zake hutengeneza kamba, magunia na mazulia.
crops.en_fact: Its fibre makes rope, sacks and mats.
